name: Seeking Strahad
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
I have taught you skills in the past, but the time has come for another to teach you. He is in Ratchet, and his name is Strahad. He is human, but do not let that fool you into thinking he is weak, nor is he your enemy... at least for now. He is powerful and should be respected. He can teach you about greater summonings, summonings I feel you are prepared for. Go to him now.

You can find him in Ratchet... above the port town next to the tower there.
narrative.offerRewardText:
A busy day in Ratchet, isn't it? How I enjoy watching the toil of a port city. So much mystery, so much adventure... so much ignorance.

Is that hatred I see in your eyes, adventurer? Good, we will put that to good use.

quests.objectiveText: Retrieve the Moldy Tome and Tattered Manuscript for Jorah Annison in the Undercity.

quests.name: Tome of the Cabal
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Reconstructed Tome and 3 Rods of Channeling to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.

quests.name: The Binding
quests.objectiveText: Using the Tome of the Cabal, summon and subdue a felhunter, then return the Tome of the Cabal to Strahad Farsan in Ratchet.
